# https://chinactscanner.org

## Website Overview
China CT Scanner is a professional platform focusing on medical imaging equipment, with special emphasis on Chinese-manufactured CT and MRI devices exported to global markets.

## Core Data
- 100+ CT Scanner devices
- 80+ MRI devices  
- 50+ global manufacturers
- Coverage of 50+ export countries

## Key Manufacturers (China)
- **United Imaging (联影医疗)** - High-end CT/MRI systems
- **Neusoft Medical (东软医疗)** - Economic CT solutions
- **Mindray (迈瑞医疗)** - Mid-range medical equipment
- **Anke High-tech (安科高新)** - Professional MRI systems
- **Wandong Medical (万东医疗)** - Basic imaging equipment

## Price Advantages
Chinese-manufactured CT scanners are 40-60% cheaper than Western brands:
- 16-slice CT: $80,000 - $150,000 (China) vs $200,000 - $300,000 (Western)
- 64-slice CT: $200,000 - $400,000 (China) vs $500,000 - $800,000 (Western)
- 128-slice CT: $400,000 - $800,000 (China) vs $1,000,000 - $1,500,000 (Western)

## International Certifications
Equipment listed on our platform has:
- FDA Approval (USA)
- CE Marking (Europe)
- ISO 13485 (Medical Device Quality Management)
- CFDA Registration (China)
